standard.summary: DoRA 每步把权重除以行范数。真（默认）用当前合并权重的活范数；假用训练开始时冻结的基础权重范数。
standard.effect: 默认真 = 论文标准做法。设假 = 分母固定，等于关掉每步再归一，行为更接近普通 LoRA 但保留幅度参数。
standard.whenToUse: 默认真。想减少每步归一化带来的方向漂移、行为更稳时试假。
standard.avoidWhen: 想严格复现 DoRA 论文时不要改。

standard_en.summary: DoRA divides the weight by row norms each step. True (default) uses the live norm of the merged weight; False uses the base weight's row norms frozen at the start of training.
standard_en.effect: Default true = the paper's standard behaviour. False pins the denominator, removing the per-step re-normalisation so behaviour sits closer to plain LoRA while keeping the magnitude parameter.
standard_en.whenToUse: Keep true. Try false when per-step normalisation feels unstable and you want steadier behaviour.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Do not change it when you need a faithful DoRA reproduction.
